name: music-video-ai
description: AI Music Video Creator — still-image Ken Burns music videos with AI storyboarding

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @music-video/web" "npm run dev -w @music-video/api"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @music-video/web" "npm run dev -w @music-video/api" "npm run dev -w @music-video/worker"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @music-video/web
